results.title: Ego
results.overview: Molecular gastronomy, pretentious self-realization and the weird choice to have children are all ingredients in this semi-apocalyptic double date from hell.

results.title: Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Road Trip
results.original_title: Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Road Trip
results.overview: Eleven-year-old Alexander and his family embark on a dream Spring Break vacation to Mexico City only to have all their plans go terribly wrong when they discover a cursed idol.

results.title: Finnick 2
results.overview: Finnick accidentally loses invisibility, and now the world of brownies is under threat. Together with his man Kristina, he goes in search of a magical magician who will help him regain invisibility.

results.title: MZ College Student and Young Aunt
results.overview: The thrilling and suspicious cohabitation of a young and sexy aunt and a lustful MZ college student begins. Tae-hoon, who has been accepted to college in Seoul, comes to the city imagining his college life by himself but becomes disappointed when his mother calls him to stay at her friend Kyeong-sook’s house. However, he is delighted when he sees the middle-aged woman Kyeong-sook’s young and sexy body, so he happily settles in. While imagining sex with his mother’s friend, who has fair skin and seductive eyes, Tae-hoon, who comes home early, witnesses the mature woman performing an adult broadcast in her room and relieves his sexual desires by watching her stream. However, Tae-hoon gets worried about how to deal with Kyeong-sook and confides in his friend Min-wook, who suggests using her broadcast as a weapon to have sex with her.

results.title: A Tooth Fairy Tale
results.overview: Van, the brave son of a tooth fairy leader, meets the goblins girl Gemma on his first mission. Despite the myths about ancient disputes between fairies and goblins, they share common values. When the greedy Spider Queen threatens both tribes, they must work together.

results.title: The South
results.overview: 1939. Juan, a city-bred librarian, decides to help his uncle with the family ranch in the countryside, heading south to honor his creole lineage.

results.title: The Legend of Condor Hero: What is Love
results.overview: Yang Guo, orphaned and wandering since childhood, became a disciple of Guo Jing but faced bullying in the Quanzhen Sect due to his mysterious background. He eventually left to study martial arts under Xiao Longnv. Meanwhile, King Jinlun and rogue disciple Li Mochou sought to seize martial arts secrets and strategic maps. Caught in the conflicts of the martial world, Yang Guo and Xiao Longnv faced numerous challenges, and their bond deepened into a bittersweet love.

results.title: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter II - The Ashes of Rage
results.original_title: 劇場版モノノ怪 第二章 火鼠
results.overview: The Medicine Seller returns as the Edo harem faces a new crisis, with family feuds, inner turmoil and fiery envy igniting the birth of a raging spirit.

results.title: Truth & Treason
results.overview: In 1941 Nazi Germany, 16-year-old Helmuth Hübener begins questioning the regime after learning the truth about the war and seeing his Jewish friend persecuted. With two friends, he secretly listens to banned foreign broadcasts and distributes leaflets exposing Nazi lies. As the Gestapo closes in, the teenagers face mounting danger for choosing conscience over obedience. Based on the true story of one of Germany’s youngest resistance fighters.

results.title: Left-Handed Girl
results.overview: A mother and her two daughters move to Taipei to open a noodle stand at a vibrant night market, but family secrets and tradition test their fresh start.

results.title: The Unbreakable Boy
results.overview: When Scott and Teresa LeRette learn that their son Austin is both autistic and has brittle bone disease, they initially worry for their son’s future. But with Scott’s growing faith and Austin’s incredible spirit, they become 'unbreakable', finding joy, gratitude, and courage even in the most trying times.

results.title: Meat Kills
results.overview: Mirthe, a member of the 'Animal Army', secretly films a pig farm's horrors, freeing its children but facing a bloody battle between Nasha's vengeance and the farmer's fury.

results.title: Operation Pope
results.overview: At the Kremlin's behest, Bulgarian secret services, along with Polish comrades, prepare for an attempt on the Pope's life. The best candidate to cover up the tracks and eliminate the assassin is retired SB agent Konstanty Brusicki, nicknamed 'Bruno', who has only one month left to live.

results.title: The Adventure
results.overview: Because of a meteor shower, 43-year-old Huang Yuqi (Jia Bing) and 18-year-old himself (Wang Hao) exchanged souls, and the man and the sophomore boy accidentally fell into a burst of dual-time laughter.

results.title: Dead End
results.overview: After witnessing his best friend Alex’s death in a tragic accident, fifteen-year-old Michael finds himself trapped in a time loop of the same day, each reset bringing more pain, hallucinations, and impossible choices — until he realizes the only way out may be to stop trying to fix the past and accept the one thing he fears most: letting go.

results.title: The Thing with Feathers
results.overview: Following the death of his wife, a young father's hold on reality crumbles, and a strange presence begins to stalk him from the shadowy recesses of the apartment he shares with his two young sons.

results.title: Ritardando
results.overview: Rumbling in the distance. Concentrated harp playing. A barricaded apartment. David does his best to shut out the rest of the world so he can practice in peace. A neighbor knocks his door and wants him to seek safety in the basement, but David is not interested. He believes in art, not war.

results.title: Manas
results.overview: Thirteen-year-old Marcielle lives on Marajó Island in the heart of the Amazon rainforest. To break a terrible cycle that imprisons the women around her in an isolated region, she must do the impossible to liberate herself and her younger sister from a dark abyss of silence held by her own family.

results.title: The Rose of Versailles
results.overview: In an age of revolution, Marie Antoinette and her protector Oscar François de Jarjayes face tough choices as women growing into their distinct roles.

results.title: Pitfall
results.overview: After a young man is separated from his friends in the woods, he falls into a ten-foot deep pit of spikes, impaling him through his leg and leaving him trapped. He quickly learns that his fall was not an accident.
